Four players remain in Las Vegas going after a WPT title.
At the World Poker Finals will one of the famous pros prevail?

696997049889f8db34c936c2: Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development, and is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.
Team 7, along with Katasuke and Chamaru, the Ninja Hound, go to the location where Konohamaru and Mugino's communications cut out and they are attacked by mysterious puppets.
After allowing Boruto and the others to escape, Ao is visited by Koji Kashin.
Team 7 works together to launch a barrage of attacks, but countering Ao’s adept use of Scientific Ninja Tools will not be easy. Just as they seem to have cornered him, Ao reveals his greatest weapon.
As Boruto and his friends finish their battle with Ao, Koji Kashin, a member of Kara, appears!
On their way back to the village, the team discovers an unconscious boy who has the same strange mark on his palm as Boruto.
The battle between Garo—an Outer—and Kawaki—also known as the Vessel—begins!
The team returns to the Advanced Technology Lab with Kawaki. Konohamaru has returned to the village to report on the mission.
Kawaki escapes the Advanced Technology Lab and finds himself in a bustling shopping district. Exhausted and hungry, he desperately searches for food.
Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
With the enemy's sudden appearance, Naruto, the Seventh Hokage and leader of the village, has vanished.
Boruto and the others attack Boro to save Naruto, but Boro drives them back by releasing a mysterious dark mist that paralyses his opponents.
The newly formed Team 7's all-out attack damages Boro, and their efforts seem to be successful. However, Boro uses his regenerative powers to revive himself.
Despite sustaining serious damage from the new Team 7, Boro goes on a mad rampage, threatening Boruto and the others with total annihilation.
Kawaki begins to worry that his presence puts Hidden Leaf Village at risk, especially since Kara is after him.
In order to learn more about Boro’s connection to Kara, Konohamaru and Sai are tasked with a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult.
Someone has stolen data about the Leaf Ninja, and it’s suspected a spy may have been planted inside the village.
Amado, a principal member of Kara who oversaw their research and development, kidnaps Shikadai and seeks asylum in the Leaf Village.
In exchange for being granted asylum in the Village Hidden in the Leaves, Amado reveals everything he knows.
The battle between Koji Kashin and Jigen begins at Kara’s hideout.
Isshiki finally appears in his true form and goes to attack the Hidden Leaf Village to capture Kawaki.
6a70da97a4bf6cded4fdaf53: Dora and Boots try to keep a very sleepy Baby Bear awake long enough to get her home for her winter nap.
Dora, Emma, and Kate help Gus the bus take all of the instruments to the kids at music school.
Dora and Boots need to help the Fairy Godmother fix her magic wand, so she can get her puppy back!
Dora, Boots, and Diego set out to rescue their bunny, turtle and butterfly animalito friends and bring them back home to their Copal Tree.
Dora and Boots rush to take Dora's Night Light to the Library before it gets too dark for the little chickens' special story time.
Dora and Boots journey deep into the Never-to-be-Seen-Again Forest so they can bring magic water back from Sparkling Lake and save the magic in Fairytale Land.
Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off to meet him.
Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.
What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

5f1213ba0ecebc00070e170f: Veja três elefantes órfãos aprenderem as habilidades de sobrevivência na mata.
Esta é a história de um dia na vida de uma família Indris na floresta tropical do Parque Nacional de Mantadia em Madagascar.
Madagascar é um mundo estranho e único de endemismo biológico incomparável. A quarta ilha mais antiga do mundo e a maior, está isolada há 88 milhões de anos.

Neste episódio, exploramos a vida das criaturas de sangue frio de Madagascar. Camaleões, sapos, lagartos e cobras se adaptaram para sobreviver na ilha. Damos uma olhada em como encontram comida, se reproduzem e evitam predadores.

Muitas espécies chamam de casa o Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia, mas ele tem uma das estações de seca mais difíceis imagináveis ​​- sem chuva por sete meses e temperaturas extremas. No entanto, para alguns animais, a estação seca significa oportunidade.
É outubro no Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia. A época mais quente e difícil do ano. Mas neste ano as condições da estação seca são exacerbadas por um evento global El Niño ... o Vale está no meio de uma seca.

As chuvas estão atrasadas. É a época mais brutal do ano. Os bebês que nascem na seca enfrentam a fome. Tudo está desesperado por chuva. Quando chega, é um aguaceiro em escala enorme. Criaturas alienígenas emergem em um mundo diferente.

Aruay e Anderson caminham até a margem do Rio Grande, em Ibitipoca e, pelo caminho, se deparam com uma obra de engenharia da natureza, os ninhos do joão-graveteiro, ave que constrói seus grandes ninhos com pequenos gravetos.

No meio da região de Ibitipoca, em Minas Gerais, uma gruta que era usada como refúgio dos escravos é visitada por Aruay e Anderson, que descobrem ricas informações sobre as plantas e animais da região.

A geração, as aplicações, as fontes e o ciclo do Biogás são discutidos por nossos especialistas para averiguar as vantagens e desvantagens desse combustível que já teve a sua produção incentivada pelo governo brasileiro.

685139b0f7d8b74b62f41c96: Angelina berättar sin version av historien, Jenni och Nicole försöker att muta Deena för att få höra skvallret medan Pauly planerar en gammal hederlig OG-semester. Samtidigt får Mike och Lauren fatta ett svårt beslut angående Mosey.
Vägen till El Paso får en oväntad vändning när Mike får ta emot en massa rykten och anklagelser. Han skickar dem omedelbart till gruppchatten och ett rent helvete bryter ut.

Gänget beger sig till El Paso över helgen för att se Pauly dj:a och prova line dancing. Det blir kärlek från första bettet när Mike provar en Texas-taco, men mellan Angelina och tjejerna är det allt annat än kärlek.
Festen fortsätter när DJ Pauly D tar sig an El Paso, och köttbullarna tar sig an en uggla. Men det är ett samtal från Angelina som gör att Mike får nog.
Köttbullarna snackar med djur. Jenni lyfter en fråga som ligger henne varmt om hjärtat. Angelina har äntligen ett möte med Snooki och Deena.
Struligheten kommer till slut ikapp Mike. Först i en episk duell med Angelina och sen i ett känslosamt möte med Jenni.

På Speidis hälsoretreat ryktas det om att Kaitlynn är gravid. Brandon har chockerande nyheter om sitt förhållande. Paret Wahler har svårt att hålla sams med paret Pratt, som är distraherade av möjliga kommande förändringar i deras liv.

Kaitlynn berättar för Brody att hon är gravid men oroar sig för mötet mellan honom och Kris på retreatet. Pratts & Wahlers tar äntligen itu med grälet som har splittrat gruppen och Justin inser vikten av att hålla kontakten.
Charlotte får nyheter i sociala medier som ger smärtsamma minnen, men hon försöker fokusera på framtiden - sin nya kärlek Josh, och att lappa ihop relationen med sin bästis Melissa.
Tjejerna på turné! Charlotte åker på jobbresa till Australien med Melissa. Hon känner att hon kan lita på Josh när hon är borta, men under en utekväll i Sydney begår hon ett hemskt misstag.

Väl på brittisk mark igen vill Charlotte lägga förra veckans fyllemisstag bakom sig, men kan Josh förlåta hennes snedsteg? Dessutom lägger hon stor möda på att ordna en episk 50-årsfest för sin pappa.

Charlotte blir förlåten av Josh för att ha kysst en annan kille, och försöker ta nästa steg genom att träffa hans kompisar på en utekväll. Men hennes värld vänds upp och ner när hon får veta att exet Stephen är tillbaka i Storbritannien.

Charlotte vill presentera Josh för sina föräldrar och ta nästa steg i förhållandet. Men när Josh ångrar ett hjärtligt meddelande tvivlar hon på deras relation. Samtidigt planerar Mel och Lauren en klassåterträff.

Charlotte och Mel tar med sina mammor på morsdagsresa. Men Charlottes vecka blir snart trist när hennes ex skriver om henne i sociala medier, och värre blir det när ett bråk med Josh ser ut att avsluta deras förhållande.

Saker och ting är osäkra mellan Charlotte och Josh när hon åker till Palma för en fotografering. Kommer Josh äntligen att be Charlotte bli hans flickvän, eller kommer hon att tvingas bryta deras relation för gott?

Charlotte går på premiären av 'Charlotte Show' och har fest för att fira. Men när Josh ser ett filmklipp med en annan kille i Australien väcks dåliga minnen till liv och Charlotte undrar om han nånsin kommer att säga att han älskar henne.

Jade får sällskap av drugorna Shea Coulee och Courtney Act och de skapar mat baserade på temana 'Regnbågsäkthet' och 'Tjejbandsglamour'. Hedersgäster är Little Mix-stjärnan Leigh-Anne Pinnock och Spice Girls Melanie C.
Jade Thirwall möter dragqueensen Jodie Harsh och Baga Chipz i en matlagningstävling. Domare är Jades mamma, Norma. Gäst idag är Todrick Hall som tittar förbi för att prata lite.

En grupp par tror att de medverkar i en tävling som testar deras förhållanden, men det finns en knorr. Bland dem finns lögnare som är ute efter att lura de äkta paren på prispengarna, över 100 000 dollar.

Paren har 25 000 dollar i prispotten efter att ha röstat bort ett lögnarpar i första Sanningsceremonin. Misstankarna frodas i gruppen och utredningen intensifieras. En hemlig pakt bildas, men kommer den att lyckas?
Paren börjar vänja sig vid tävlingen och förhållanden sätts på prov. Det leder till att inkonsekvenser blottas. Men betyder det att par är på låtsas, eller är det uppriktiga misstag?
